name: STAR Orbit — sizes and speeds of a Keplerian ellipse
summary: Period, mean motion, circular and escape speed, apsis radii and speeds and specific energy of a two-body ellipse; within 4e-14 relative of SPICE for any gravitational parameter and 2.6e-14 of hapsira on 600 orbits; reproduces the geostationary orbit and refuses non-elliptic input.
reference: the geostationary orbit: period of one sidereal day, 86164.0905 s, at a radius of 42164.17 km with mu = 398600.4418 km3/s2 (Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications)
reference_observed: period(42164.17) = 86164.0917 s: within 0.0012 s of the sidereal day

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: period(), semi_major_axis_from_period(), mean_motion(), circular_speed(), escape_speed(), apsides(), elements_from_apsides(), apsis_speeds(), specific_energy()
review.G-04: km, s, km3/s2 by default; any consistent set with an explicit mu
review.G-06: no external data; the default mu is stated with its source
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; ellipses only, stated; two-body limit stated
